blocks.markdown:
## What the hero worked out for itself

The stamp on the frame counts the plates on this page in Roman numerals. The caption under the frame names the portrait as plate I, from its own title. The engraved line at the foot is the author, this post's date in Roman numerals and its first subject; a salon can word it itself in the Engraved line field.
